messages:
dana: getting an urgent support escalation: embeddings endpoint returning malformed payloads and 400s for multiple customers. alert spike at ~13:45 UTC. customers reporting "errors: embedding dimension mismatch" and also big latency spikes. who's got oncall?

izzy: I'm here. can you paste an example error?

mssupport: forwarded from CS: `400 Bad Request - embedding_dim mismatch: expected 768 got 1024; request_id=rcpt_44a1` 

marc: weird — we just rolled rwd-embed-small -> v3 at 13:30 for a small perf bump. v2 had dim=1024, v3 has dim=768. that matches the numbers.

riley: router traces show mixed routing: some nodes serving v2, some v3 during the 13:35-13:50 window. autoscaler added 6 new hosts right before deploy. looks like new hosts pulled new catalog, old hosts still had v2 pinned.

izzy: root cause hypothesis: model-catalog propagation is eventually consistent, and router caching uses model name only; when some hosts refreshed catalog to v3 while others still had v2, clients that batch across hosts got mixed dims.

marc: reproducing locally:
```
# simulate client batching to two hosts with different variants
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-small","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
If requests hit mixed hosts mid-batch we see dimension errors.

mssupport: CS notes that affected customers were using implicit model (no explicit version) + large batch sizes (~100 docs) and client library v0.9 which does concurrent upload chunks.

dana: mitigation options: (A) force immediate rollback to v2; (B) disable batching on proxy for a short window so each request pins to single host; (C) add runtime validation to detect mixed-dim batches and return 409 with instructive message. Thoughts?

riley: fastest is to disable batch coalescing at proxy layer and add a short-lived header enforcement that requires clients to specify model_version in requests. can push proxy config change in 2-3m. rollback will take longer and may reintroduce perf regression.

marc: disabling coalescing could hurt throughput but rollback is riskier during ongoing scaling. I agree disable coalescing + require model_version as temporary mitigation.

deploy-bot: patch request submitted: proxy-disable-batch-coalescing (initiated by riley). status: queued.
deploy-bot: patch applied at 13:58 UTC on edge proxies in region-us-west.
izzy: monitoring now. error rate fell ~85% within 5m. p99 latency back to normal. some customers still have failures from earlier retries; CS is handling retries.
mssupport: alerted customers with ETA and mitigation steps. they asked for a permanent fix.
dana: action items for postmortem: 1) make model-catalog push atomic across control-plane; 2) change router cache key to include model_version (marc). 3) add server-side batch-dimension-validation and better 4xx payload with hint (izzy). 4) SDK change to warn when default model dims change and encourage pinning (riley). 5) improve rollout canary to monitor dim-consistency metrics (dana).
marc: I'll open PR for cache-key + catalog-sync; include unit tests that simulate staggered catalog updates.

riley: I'll start SDK warning RFC and quick patch to client library to surface dimension mismatches earlier.

mssupport: I'll prepare CS followup templates + list of affected request_ids and customers.

izzy: leaving follow-up monitoring on for 12h; if dims reappear we will escalate. marking as mitigated but not fully resolved.

dana: thanks team. closing incident thread; will add detailed timeline to postmortem board. :wave:
